name: quai-app
description: Quai : horaires des transports en commun belges en temps réel sur les lunettes Even Realities G2

scripts.dev:web: node --input-type=module -e "const { createServer } = await import('vite'); const { pathToFileURL } = await import('node:url'); const entry = '/@fs' + new URL('src/web/main.ts', pathToFileURL(process.cwd() + '/')).pathname; const server = await createServer({ configFile: 'vite.web.config.ts', plugins: [{ name: 'quai-dev-web-entry', transformIndexHtml: { order: 'pre', handler: (html) => html.replace('../src/web/main.ts', entry) } }] }); await server.listen(); server.printUrls(); server.bindCLIShortcuts({ print: true });"
scripts.pack: node scripts/check-configured.mjs && npm run build && evenhub pack app.json dist -o quai.ehpk --sdk-ver 0.0.16
